source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.9.1, printed page 206.

blocks.text: Titration mein indicator istemal karne ki do aam sharten (criteria) yeh hain:

items: Titration ke aakhir mein pH indicator ke neutral point (jahan rang badalta hai) ke qareeb ho.
Indicator equivalence point ke qareeb rang ki tez (sharp) tabdeeli dikhaye.

blocks.text: Har pH indicator pH ki ek muqarrar range mein rang badalta hai, jise indicator range kehte hain. Indicator taqreeban 2 pH units ki range mein rang badalta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Indicator aisa chunein jis ki rang badalne wali range titration curve ke seedhe (tez uchhal wale) hisse mein aaye. Methyl orange 3.2 se 4.5 aur phenolphthalein 8.2 se 10.0 par rang badalte hain (Table 9.7, topic 9.9.2).

items: Indicator ki rang ki tabdeeli (taqreeban 2 pH units chauri) equivalence point ke qareeb aur tez honi chahiye.
